blocks.text: Have you ever wondered how your phone charges or how a car moves? These are examples of energy in action!

blocks.markdown: Energy is all around us and comes in different forms. Understanding these forms helps us see how they power our daily lives.

blocks.title: Definition of Energy
blocks.text: Energy is the ability to do work or cause change. It can exist in various forms such as heat, light, sound, electrical, and mechanical.

blocks.markdown: Let's explore some common forms of energy and see how they are used in Nigeria.

items: Heat Energy: Found in cooking food on a stove.
Light Energy: Used in streetlights to illuminate roads at night.
Sound Energy: Produced by speakers at a party.
Electrical Energy: Powers home appliances like fridges and TVs.
Mechanical Energy: Seen in a bicycle moving when pedaled.

blocks.title: Energy Transformation Example
blocks.prompt: How does energy transform in a car engine?

steps.text: 1. The car engine burns fuel, releasing chemical energy.
2. The chemical energy is converted into mechanical energy, moving the car.

blocks.answer: In a car engine, chemical energy from the fuel is transformed into mechanical energy to move the car.

blocks.markdown: Energy can change from one form to another. This transformation is essential for many devices and processes.

blocks.title: Exam Tip
blocks.text: Remember, energy transformation is key in many applications. Be ready to identify examples in exams.
